---
title: "My first weeks in MDS"
author: "Tin Yan Rachel Lee"
date: 2026-09-09
---

The first week of MDS has been both exciting and challenging. Being a student again after a few years of working feels quite different, and I’m trying my best to adjust to the student schedule and rebuild my learning habits. In the prerequisite courses, we had already covered some of the concepts introduced in the first week, so we were not completely overwhelmed. However, starting from the second week, new knowledge has been coming at us quickly! Discipline and persistence will definitely be our best friends throughout the program.

As mentioned, the pace of MDS is very fast, so time management is an important skill for succeeding in the program. Outside of studying, I also think it is crucial to set aside time for both our physical and mental well-being, as well as for the people we care about. It is definitely easier said than done, but over these 10 months, I will try to remind myself from time to time to maintain a healthy balance between school and life.
